independent.scope: The frozen public-only checker read all six exact public ordinary artifacts directly; no private diagnostics or projection transform were supplied.

mechanics.coverage: Closed integer hull center samples, three-prism union counted once; target and forbidden predicates are independent.
mechanics.controls: Quarter-turn rigid workpiece and eight-sector directional source; each rotation costs one adjustment.
mechanics.lastAdjustment: Fresh coverage success is evaluated before exhausted-budget loss.
mechanics.clues: Visible marked foot, registration point, post height and projected tip; guides themselves never decide success.
mechanics.clock: Actual admitted calls and accepted dt only; no timer loss or hidden physics steps.

testNames: only the accepted API and deeply frozen exact public task data are exported
creation normalizes seeds and levels and detaches every round from configuration
all three initial masks and separate hit counts equal the public hand calculations
synthetic public-guide geometries cover exactly the authored targets and avoid forbidden cells
rigid quarter yaw rotates all centers about the translated pivot
all eight source sectors cast in the opposite direction with the specified diagonal slope
closed diagonal hull edges include the extra boundary samples and exclude exterior neighbors
footprints and doubled vertices represent grounded boxes with real height scaling
overlapping prism shadows form one union rather than summed per-prism counts
equal total coverage cannot replace independent target and forbidden checks
every rotation replaces forged caches and judges fresh geometry from physical indices
absolute focus selections are free and do not rebuild or mutate the geometry
clockwise and counterclockwise steps wrap each selected ring without changing the other
rotation receipts keep exact advanced time, before/after indices and previous immutable facts
geometry arrays and guides are detached from each other, config and prior snapshots
held A or B never repeats but a released renewed press rotates again
B then A priority consumes all simultaneous edges and rotates the old focus
threshold, clamping, vertical ties and changed direction tokens select one focus edge
start and retry quarantine held controls until a noncancelled neutral sample
epoch changes and persistent cancellation suppress stale holds without synthetic release
first epoch establishes a baseline, invalid epochs are inert and cancellation rising disarms
only own literal data fields are admitted while getters and inherited controls remain inert
malformed containers normalize to armable neutral without value coercion or source inference
throwing descriptor and revoked proxies discard every partial field before paused handling
invalid dt and own literal paused calls preserve every value and reference without reading invalid input
admitted time advances once per call without held repeats or hidden physics ticks
synthetic counter and clock caps signal overflow only and do not settle a round
twelve ordinary WORK presses with each original lamp produce genuine budget exhaustion
a labeled synthetic twelfth-adjustment success wins before budget exhaustion
neutral and focus calls never adjudicate a synthetic matching pose or cached matched flag
both terminal outcomes freeze geometry receipts gates events and clocks before input access
public integer hulls are canonical, bounded, nondegenerate and use the finite 169-cell board
synthetic mathematical exterior clipping example is separate from reachable Model poses
identical held sequences are deterministic across seeds and retry restores fresh round state

finalLayoutReview.scope: Root personally reviewed current source and all60 original image files with separate peers. Actual formal34 checks, ordinary654fullcalls, independent public endpoints, browser controls, finalQA, signedasset identity and clean actualrecording accepted for packaging. Count only after verified masterpush.
limitations: No physical TV or phone test. Browser render submissions and export30FPS do not establish hardware frame rate.
Sparse browser/media endpoints cannot establish every hidden dt/input/lifecycle transition; explicit gaps retained.
60 files include repeated pixel states; file count is not unique state count.
Twelve encoded/sourcepairs were visually inspected; remaining video frames verified by full decode, not exhaustive manualframe viewing.
Initial browser startup failure, corrected readout overlap and initial recording metadata preflight failure retained with causes and fixes.

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.
performance.scope: Counts are API submissions during observer RAF intervals; RAF intervals are not render CPU cost or measured television FPS.

terminalHold.scope: Conservative actual wall interval between retained read boundaries; every retained terminal model agrees. Sparse observations, not frame-exact state attribution.

shadowFoundry.finalScreenshotClockScope: last-CDP-timestamp plus measured reception-clock delta; estimated cross-clock placement
shadowFoundry.scope: All state readStartedAt/readCompletedAt fields bound real awaited reads; browser observations remain sparse.

invocationHistory.scope: First command rejected a root-supplied metadata shape before output creation or browser startup. The corrected command is the first actual capture; all original metadata and logs remain retained.

sparseFinalAudit.scope: Lossless selection and segmentation only. Projection time is not game time; no execution, geometry, lifecycle or independent-audit pass is asserted.
